scope: Owned /tmp home/profile, loopback HTTP, actual TTY and actual manager component. No real user configuration edits, model requests, third-party patches, tag or publication.
problem: MCP rename saves the patch before group metadata. A private-config lock timeout or interruption leaves the valid old serverName/entryId pair unmatched after restart.
identityBoundary: Same entryId is a candidate only. The user explicitly chooses old -> current name and confirms identity continuity; no automatic assignment, deletion or durable intent queue.
setupNote: Initial fixture boot rejected a comment-only home patch as a non-array. Replaced only the owned fixture with an empty YAML array; both subsequent test sessions exited normally.

limits: The user must establish identity continuity; id reuse cannot be detected automatically.
Only same entryId + different name mappings to unique current-profile definitions. Home/duplicate/foreign override targets refuse repair.
Migrated references do not automatically return when an old identity is restored later.
Backups contain the full private config; exact bytes, file 0600, batch directory 0700. Other profiles/unknown/hidden records preserved as data; JSON formatting can change.
No atomic transaction across patch/config or durable rename journal. Final-check-to-rename race with non-cooperating writers remains.
No new 0.19 runtime proof, cross-platform/OS-crash proof, arbitrary remote credentials/TLS or model request coverage. KI-01..03 and AC-15 remain open.
